adopted_modules.capability: source-grounded fact extraction and evidence boundaries
page thesis, reading path, layout pattern and collision budget
chart semantics, frame budget and editable export boundary
declarative HTML animation and PPTX downgrade boundary

rejected: treating the HTML workbench as a native PPTX exporter
copying upstream templates, fonts, images, models or private assets
runtime_boundary: The adapter contributes guidance and provider status. It does not claim that Oh My PPT is installed or that a provider-backed export ran unless the runtime is independently discovered and executed.
